Clipping Chair
Design & Style: Modern armless chair featuring a smooth, curved backrest profile for a streamlined and space-saving aesthetic.
Backrest Feature: Distinctive contrasting white central back panel beautifully adorned with an intricate, cut-out floral rose-clipping pattern.
Color Palette: Deep navy blue frame that creates a striking visual contrast against the crisp white floral insert.
Seat Construction: Ergonomically contoured seat surface with subtle horizontal ribbing lines for enhanced seating comfort.
Leg Architecture: Robust, wide-set vertical legs offering solid stability and a balanced foundation.

Sonata Audi Chair
Design & Style: Contemporary armless chair featuring a high backrest with a prominent, multi-slotted design for enhanced breathability.
Backrest Feature: Eye-catching dual-tone upper accent featuring four circular cut- out rings near the top crown, mirroring a classic luxury motif.
Color Palette: Bold green frame complemented by a bright yellow contrasting central back insert and brand badge detailing.
Seat Construction: Smooth, comfortably contoured seat surface tailored for ergonomic support during extended sitting.
Leg Architecture: Sturdy and durable wide-set vertical legs offering a stable and reliable foundation for everyday use.

Round Dining Table
Design & Style: Modern circular dining table featuring a sleek, grid-patterned top surface.
Surface Features: Center umbrella hole included to support outdoor patio shading options.
Color Palette: Vibrant red tabletop paired with a contrasting dark black base structure.
Storage Shelf: Built-in circular lower shelf providing convenient space for storage and added structural support.
Leg Construction: Sturdy, wide-stance angled legs designed for maximum stability and durability.

Square Dining Table
Design & Style: Rectangular table featuring a spacious, flat top surface with rounded edges and a decorative wood-grain finish texture.
Surface Features: Integrated central umbrella hole to accommodate outdoor shading options.
Storage Shelf: Convenient lower slatted storage shelf built between the legs for keeping items organized and off the ground.
Color Palette: Warm wood-toned brown top surface contrasted by a sturdy dark black base and legs.
Leg Construction: Strong, wide-set angled legs designed to provide dependable support and stability.

Round Tea Table
Design & Shape: Features a classic round tabletop with a modern geometric grid/tile pattern etched on the surface and a textured outer rim.
Color Scheme: Dual-tone aesthetic with a warm terracotta/reddish-brown top paired with contrasting black legs and lower shelf.
Material: Constructed from durable, lightweight plastic material that is easy to move, clean, and maintain.
Storage Shelf: Includes a lower perforated black shelf beneath the main surface, providing convenient extra space for magazines, remotes, or small storage items.
Structure & Base: Supported by four sturdy black legs for stability, making it suitable for both indoor (living room/balcony) and outdoor (patio/garden) use.

Square Tea Table
Design & Shape: Features a rectangular tabletop with rounded corners, complete with a subtle grid pattern on the surface and a textured outer rim.
Color Scheme: Dual-tone styling with a light brown/caramel-colored top and contrasting solid black legs and shelf.
Material: Made from durable, lightweight plastic, making it easy to move, clean, and maintain.
Storage Shelf: Equipped with a black, diamond-mesh lower shelf for storing newspapers, magazines, remotes, or other household essentials.
Structure & Base: Supported by four thick black legs that provide balanced support for indoor or outdoor use.

Two-Tone Utility Stool
Design & Style: Compact, square-top utility stool featuring a clean and sturdy profile for everyday seating or utility needs.
Color Palette: Vibrant red lower base and frame contrasted with a smooth, bright white seat surface.
Seat Features: Designed with a central circular accent detail on the top surface that breaks up the dual-tone look and features the KOLPLAST brand logo on the front.
Leg Construction: Strong, stable vertical legs reinforced with horizontal support structures to ensure reliable everyday weight distribution.
